settings.title: Tell us the bag
settings.text: Start with the color you carry most. That becomes the base.

settings.title: Pick the signal
settings.text: Choose one accent color. The best setups repeat it without getting loud.

settings.title: Choose the intensity
settings.text: Clean, Starter, Tour, or Gift tells the system how much gear to recommend.

settings.title: Minimal essentials
settings.text: Best for golfers who want a sharper bag without adding clutter.

settings.title: Full setup
settings.text: Best for golfers who want towel, cover, tools, cart add-ons, and practice pieces aligned.

settings.title: Safe and polished
settings.text: Best when you know they golf, but you do not know every detail of their bag.

settings.heading: Find the right build before you shop.
settings.subheading: A simple decision path for turning bag color, accent color, and setup style into a cart that makes sense.
